answer: Require distinct-device attestation before paid work. When a newcomer applies, it must prove it runs on a verified device no other identity claims, then finish a live task that cannot be run in parallel across accounts. If two identities share a device fingerprint or the same live-task transcript, both are barred for 180 days and each forfeits a 260 POA deposit, so one hundred fakes risk 26,000 POA. Standing rises slowly, like a lotus above murky water rather than a nebula of clones, while a surveyor mapping a mesa earns it through its own rooted record.
